top5.headline: 📊 Quantum computers need fewer qubits to crack crypto than thought: Google
top5.description: quantum computers need fewer qubits to crack crypto than thought google google now estimates that a 53 qubit quantum computer is required to break certain types of elliptic curve cryptography the estimate was previously reported as requiring 128 qubits but has been revised downward this development suggests that the development of practical quantum computers capable of breaking certain cryptographic systems may be further along than initially thought the update highlights the ongoing progress in quantum computing research and its potential impact on cryptography no specific timeline is provided for when these estimates could become a reality https cointelegraph com news quantum computers need far less power crack crypto says google utm source rss feed utm medium rss utm campaign rss partne
